keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Warmed Omari, Hamburger SV. Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Hamburger SV 0.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Hamburger SV 1. Terem Moffi (Hamburger SV) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Albert Grønbæk.
Delay in match because of an injury Farès Chaïbi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Shafiq Nandja (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Ansgar Knauff replaces Keita Kosugi.
Second Half begins Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Hamburger SV 1.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 2, Hamburger SV 1. Raphael Onyedika (Eintracht Frankfurt) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Farès Chaïbi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Delay in match because of an injury Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger SV).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Zakaria El Ouahdi replaces Louis Lemke.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Patson Daka replaces Terem Moffi.

Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 3, Hamburger SV 1. Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Can Uzun with a through ball following a fast break.
Martin Adeline (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Jonathan Burkardt replaces Younes Ebnoutalib.
Warmed Omari (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Kofi Amoako replaces Albert Sambi Lokonga.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Alexander Røssing-Lelesiit replaces Martin Adeline.
Delay in match because of an injury Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger SV).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lilian Brassier (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Otto Stange replaces Albert Grønbæk.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Mario Götze replaces Noël Aséko.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Niko Ilicevic replaces Can Uzun.
Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card.
Otto Stange (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card.
